description: A shell script for managing protobuf code generation, including version checks, protoc installation, and code formatting within the Kubernetes project.

methods.name: kube::protoc::generate_proto
methods.description: Generates Go protobuf code from a .proto file and formats it.

methods.name: kube::protoc::check_protoc
methods.description: Checks if the installed protoc version matches the required version.

methods.name: kube::protoc::protoc
methods.description: Runs protoc to generate Go code from a specified directory containing api.proto.

methods.name: kube::protoc::format
methods.description: Formats generated protobuf Go files and adds boilerplate comments.

methods.name: kube::protoc::diff
methods.description: Compares two files and exits if they differ.

methods.name: kube::protoc::install
methods.description: Installs the protoc compiler for the current platform.

methods.name: kube::protoc::loaded
methods.description: Marker function indicating the script has been sourced.
